prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. A lush northern hillside landscape study with one understated possible cream residence mass nestled behind mature greenery and basalt terraces. Vegetation is the subject; building is a small incomplete sketch. Cool overcast Atlantic atmosphere. Different from coastal cliff views: look across a shallow green valley with layered planted slopes. No exact site, road alignment or development plan.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
